shortDescription: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions NSE:CLEANMAX said on Thursday it plans to invest nearly 500 billion rupees ($5.34 billion) to build an integrated renewable energy complex that will power a 2-gigawatt AI computing facility in India's Andhra Pradesh.($1 = 93.6400 Indian rupees)

children: said on Thursday it plans to invest nearly 500 billion rupees ($5.34 billion) to build an integrated renewable energy complex that will power a 2-gigawatt AI computing facility in India's Andhra Pradesh.

The company has signed a memorandum of understanding with the state government to develop 3 GW of wind and solar power generation capacity and 1 GW of pumped hydro storage facilities over the next five years
The projects will support round-the-clock electricity supply to the computing facility being developed in the Kurnool district in collaboration with Blackstone-backed AI cloud provider Neysa
The announcement follows a string of major investment proposals in Andhra Pradesh on Thursday, including Reliance Industries'
planned $4.6-billion coal-to-gas project and a $2-billion investment by Kia and its suppliers in a second manufacturing plant
Neysa will anchor the Kurnool facility with 1 GW of computing capacity, while Clean Max will develop the power generation, storage and distribution infrastructure
Clean Max said the projects would be developed in phases, with at least 1.5 GW of renewable energy capacity proposed to be developed by 2029
Clean Max, listed on Indian stock exchanges in March, said data centre and AI infrastructure customers accounted for 41% of its contracted renewable energy power sales portfolio as of September
